rationale: The spec's devcontainer-reference lists `.devcontainer/<folder>/devcontainer.json` (one level deep) as a discovery location. deacon searches it; the pinned reference v0.87.0 requires an explicit --config and exits non-zero. deacon is on the spec's side, so the difference is characterized rather than followed — the waiver records that the reference is blind to a location the spec names, and self-invalidates if a later oracle starts searching it.
